• Oversee contractor compliance with project HSE requirements and international

best practices.

• Participate in site audits, inspections, and leadership safety walks.

• Review major risk activities and ensure appropriate controls are implemented.

• Lead independent reviews of signiﬁcant incidents and corrective actions.

Schedule and Performance Management

• Monitor construction progress against baseline schedules.

• Identify schedule risks and delays affecting critical path activities.

• Evaluate contractor recovery programmes and acceleration strategies.

• Provide accurate progress assessments and executive-level reporting to the Client.

Commercial and Contractual Support

• Support the Commercial and Project Controls teams in evaluating claims,

variations, extension of time requests, and change orders.

• Review contractor entitlement submissions related to construction matters.

• Provide expert recommendations regarding construction performance and

contractual obligations.

• Assist in dispute avoidance and resolution activities.

Stakeholder Management

• Act as the primary construction interface between the Client, PMC team,

contractors, designers, and authorities.

• Participate in executive and steering committee meetings.

• Present construction performance updates, key risks, mitigation plans, and

strategic recommendations.

• Develop and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders.

Quality Assurance and Compliance

• Ensure construction activities comply with approved design, speciﬁcations, codes,

and standards.

• Lead quality audits and construction readiness reviews.

• Monitor inspection and test plans (ITPs) and quality control processes.

• Ensure lessons learned and continuous improvement initiatives are implemented.

Requirements

Qualiﬁcations

• Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering or related discipline.

• Master's Degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or Project Management

preferred.

• Professional Engineer (PE, CEng, or equivalent) preferred.

• Project Management certiﬁcation (PMP or equivalent) desirable.

Experience Requirements

• Minimum 20 years of experience in major infrastructure construction projects.

• Minimum 15 years of experience in tunnelling and underground works.

• Proven PMC or Client-side leadership experience on mega projects.

• Demonstrated success managing projects exceeding USD 1 billion in value.

• Extensive experience with:

o Tunnel Boring Machines (TBM) – not key, potentially micro.

o NATM / SEM / VMT

o Deep shafts and caverns

o Underground premium accommodation

o Underground infrastructure

o Utility and other infrastructure tunnels

• Experience working within international project delivery environments and complex

stakeholder frameworks.

Core Competencies

• Strategic Construction Leadership

• Tunnelling Subject Matter Expertise

• Client Representation

• Contractor Performance Management

• Construction Governance and Assurance

• Risk Management

• Health & Safety Leadership

• Commercial Awareness

• Stakeholder Management

• Schedule Management

• Quality Management

• Executive Reporting and Communication

Professional Proﬁle Statement

Senior Construction Manager with industry-leading expertise in the oversight and delivery

of large-scale, complex tunnelling and underground projects within PMC and client-side

environments. Proven track record of providing strategic construction leadership,

governance, and assurance for multi-billion-dollar programmes involving TBM (micro),

driving exceptional safety performance, managing complex contractor interfaces,

mitigating construction risks, and delivering successful project outcomes through effective

stakeholder engagement, technical excellence, and robust construction management

practices.

jobs.title: Supplier Relationship Manager

jobs.title: Support Analyst
jobs.description:
We are seeking a proactive and technically adept Support Analyst to contribute to the development, administration, and continuous enhancement of our digital platforms and data systems. This role is ideal for a detail-oriented professional with a solid foundation in business analysis, data interpretation, and technical systems—particularly within environments such as SharePoint Online, Aconex, and Power BI.

As a Support Analyst, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather and document business requirements, maintain and support portal infrastructure, and assist in automating data processes. You will play a key role in ensuring that digital tools and platforms are aligned with evolving business needs, while also supporting end-users through training, documentation, and troubleshooting.

 This position requires a strong blend of analytical thinking, technical proficiency, and communication skills. You will be expected to follow best practices in change management, the software development lifecycle (SDLC), and digital document control, while staying current with emerging technologies and industry trends to support innovation and operational excellence. 

* Assist in gathering and documenting business requirements by coordinating with stakeholders and supporting senior analysts in aligning initiatives with strategic and knowledge management goals.

* Support data collection and basic analysis tasks to aid decision-making and reporting efforts across the organization.

* Utilize AI-powered tools such as Microsoft Copilot to assist in automating routine reporting, organizing information, and enhancing team productivity.

* Help manage and maintain structured and unstructured data repositories, ensuring information is accurately captured and accessible.

* Translate technical information into user-friendly formats and assist in preparing documentation and training materials for various audiences.

* Promote data literacy by supporting training sessions and helping team members and stakeholders understand and use data effectively.

* Provide administrative and coordination support to ensure timely delivery of team outputs and high-quality deliverables.

* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support seamless information flow and assist in coordinating project activities.

* Assist in aligning KM support activities with broader organizational strategies through regular communication with team leads and management.

* Demonstrate initiative and problem-solving skills by supporting the resolution of day-to-day operational challenges.

* Stay informed about relevant tools, technologies, and best practices in business analysis and knowledge management.

* Help maintain digital document control systems such as Aconex, ensuring compliance with standards and supporting operational discipline.

* Support automation and data tasks using basic programming or scripting knowledge (e.g., Python, SQL) under guidance.

* Assist in creating and updating data visualizations and dashboards using tools like Power BI.

Requirements

* 5+ years relevant experience with Bachelors in related field; will consider experience in lieu of degree

* Understanding of SharePoint Online architecture, features, and functionality, including site creation, permissions management, and customization.

* PMP or other relevant project management certification (e.g., Prince2, Agile, etc.) - Desirable 

* 2+ years’ experience working in a multi-skilled team environment collaborating on data automation

* Experience with integrating SharePoint Online with other Microsoft 365 services like Teams, OneDrive, and Power Automate.

* Proficiency in scripting languages automate administrative tasks and create custom solutions.

* Knowledge of Windows Server and IIS for managing SharePoint environments.

* Experience with planning and executing SharePoint migrations and upgrades.

* Collaboration: Ability to work effectively with teams, stakeholders, and end-users to understand their needs and ensure successful rollout.

* Experience working with structured and unstructured data with the ability to automate data processing and analysis tasks.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Able to convey complex, technical issues in an easy-to-understand manner

* Strong organizational and planning skills for tracking requests and project fulfillment.

* Flexibility and adaptability in responding to changing business requirements.

* Effectively manages and prioritizes workload and delivers to tight deadlines.  

* Demonstrate Strong written and verbal skills in English.

* Demonstrate proficient use of enterprise-level management software, such as (e.g., Microsoft Project, Primavera, Aconex, etc.) or similar systems

* Excellent problem-solving, decision-making, and conflict resolution skills.

jobs.title: Survey Engineer
jobs.description:

jobs.title: System Analyst / Junior Project Manager (IT)

jobs.title: Technical Engineer - Infrastructure

jobs.title: Testing & Commissioning Manager (EOI)
jobs.description:

We are partnering with a reputable institution to deliver high‑profile sports and recreational facilities in Riyadh. This initiative will create a state‑of‑the‑art, refurbished and upgraded complex designed to provide high‑quality accommodation and amenities for sport and leisure—aligned with the project’s primary objectives. The project team will apply proven project management and construction‑supervision expertise to ensure on‑time delivery, strict cost control, and adherence to the highest quality and safety standards. We seek an exceptional, collaborative team committed to excellence and ready to contribute the skills and dedication required to deliver this scheme successfully.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement comprehensive testing and commissioning plans for sport facilities, including HVAC, electrical, lighting, security, and other related systems.
  • Coordinate and oversee testing activities to verify system functionality and compliance with design specifications and regulatory standards.
  • Manage all commissioning processes to ensure seamless handover of facilities to stakeholders.
  • Liaise closely with engineering, construction, and client teams to resolve issues promptly and efficiently.
  • Prepare detailed documentation and reports outlining testing results, commissioning status, and any non-conformance issues.
  • Identify potential risks during commissioning and implement mitigation strategies.
  • Lead and mentor the testing and commissioning team to ensure adherence to safety and quality standards.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for all testing and commissioning related communications.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, preferably Mechanical, Electrical, or related fields.
  • At least 10 years of experience in testing and commissioning of large-scale sports facilities or similar infrastructure projects.
  • Proven track record of managing complex commissioning activities and teams.
  • Strong knowledge of sports facility systems, codes, and standards.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and project management skills.
  • Ability to analyze technical issues and provide effective solutions.
  • Experience coordinating with multidisciplinary teams and stakeholders.
  • Commitment to safety and quality assurance in commissioning processes.
  • Relevant certifications in project management or commissioning are advantageous.
